recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: 93% turkey browned with onion and pepper, then black beans, salsa, and cumin. Rice pouch and avocado on the side.
steps: Dice onion and bell pepper. Heat a skillet over medium-high with a little oil.
Brown turkey with onion and pepper, breaking it up, 8–10 min.
Stir in drained beans, chili powder, cumin, salt, and salsa. Simmer 3 min.
Heat rice pouch. Plate skillet over rice with avocado, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.title: One-pot chicken tomato pasta
recipes.summary: Chicken breast cooked with garlic, crushed tomato, spinach, and whole-wheat pasta in one pot. Parmesan to finish.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Sear in a pot with oil, salt, and pepper until just cooked; pull to a plate.
Saute garlic 30 sec. Add crushed tomatoes, 2 cups water, pasta, and a pinch of salt. Simmer uncovered, stirring, until pasta is al dente, about 12 min.
Fold chicken and spinach back in until spinach wilts. Finish with Parmesan and basil.

recipes.title: Garlic-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: Her plate: EZ-peel shrimp with broccoli, pepper, soy, and ginger over jasmine rice. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)

steps: Peel shrimp if needed; pat dry. Cut broccoli into florets and pepper into strips. Heat rice pouch.
Hot skillet, oil almost smoking. Garlic and ginger 20 sec. Shrimp 2 min until just pink; pull.
Stir-fry broccoli and pepper 3–4 min. Splash soy. Return shrimp, toss, top with green onion. Serve over rice.
His plate: same veg and rice; cook the chicken thighs in the same pan instead of shrimp.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan lemon salmon and potatoes
recipes.summary: Her plate: Atlantic salmon roasted with potatoes and green beans, lemon finish. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)
1.5 lb small red or gold potatoes

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast 12 min.
Add green beans and salmon (oil, salt, pepper, lemon zest). Roast 12–14 min more until salmon flakes.
Squeeze lemon, scatter parsley. His plate: same tray timing with chicken thighs instead of salmon.
